$comment: Semantics: a doc phrase may appear ONLY IF the required symbol exists in the tree.
Every row is a fact, never an opinion: a hit means the doc describes behaviour whose
implementing symbol is not in this checkout (typically it lives in a still-open PR).
Adding a row: copy one, change 'phrases', 'requires' and 'reason'. Nothing else.

claims.reason: Docs promise rendered/sanitized markdown answers, which needs the ResponseMarkdown renderer. Without it the plugin renders plain text.
Docs promise Map links into Explore / the Drilldown apps, which are built by src/utils/grafanaExplore.ts.
Docs promise a show-me phrase path that skips the engine. No non-test source handles it; the only match in the tree is a test fixture.
Docs describe a condensed Prior block packed into the intent. progressiveContext.ts has no Prior packing.
